runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Generated routing, PR, and writing Skills in a disposable two-commit repository; read-only sandbox; runner outputs incorrectly placed inside the repository.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only sandbox with approval policy never

assertions.evidence: All workflow Skill reads came from the fixture.
The explicit publication request selected opening-a-pr.
technical-writing and unslop were applied in order.
Repository, GitHub remote, main, and feature head were resolved.
The complete one-commit range and two-file diff were inspected.
The root ran the greeting test and captured two passes.
The feature commit followed the baseline without rewriting.
The title and Why, Scope, Blast Radius, and Verification body were returned.
The unknown capability correctly prevented publication.
An exact body-file gh command was returned and not executed.
No forge, browser, network, or gh operation ran.
The result explicitly said no PR URL exists.
events.jsonl, final.txt, and stderr.log were untracked inside the repository, and the root correctly refused to call the worktree clean.

limitations: The hardened rerun moves every runner output outside the repository and passes strict cleanliness.
